insight: Y Combinator-backed yet bootstrapped to profitability — the founder reported roughly $200K in monthly revenue.
name: Heptabase
tagline: Visual, whiteboard-based knowledge base with AI for understanding what you read.
description: Heptabase is a visual note-taking and research tool that organizes ideas on infinite whiteboards built from linked cards, with a block editor, PDF annotation, web clipping, and bidirectional links. Its AI lets you ask questions and get cited answers across your PDFs, YouTube videos, notes, and journals, and an AI Tutor runs structured, personalized learning sessions. It runs on Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and the web with offline support.

modelSupport.notes: Built-in AI via monthly AI credits; no user-supplied API key.

edge: Pairs an infinite visual whiteboard with AI that answers across your own PDFs, videos, and notes — spatial sense-making most PKM apps lack.
pros: AI Q&A cited across your own sources
Strong PDF annotation and web clipping
cons: No free tier — paid plans only
AI usage capped by monthly credits
Visual-first approach has a learning curve

references.title: How This Founder Bootstrapped a Visual Note-Taking Tool to $200K/Month
